title: Early-2000s camcorder clip
summary: A short clip that looks like it was filmed on a family camcorder around 2004, timestamp and all.
why: Retro camcorder clips are one of the AI video formats people are sharing most this autumn. The home-video look makes AI video feel warm and real instead of glossy.
steps: Start from your own photo for the first frame, or use text to video.
Paste the main prompt and generate 2–3 versions.
Add the date overlay in your editor if the AI's text comes out messy.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Handheld home video from a consumer camcorder around 2004. A family kitchen on a Saturday morning: someone flips pancakes, a kid reaches for the syrup, everyone laughs. Square 4:3 frame, slightly washed-out colours, soft focus that hunts for a moment, a little shake, a small white timestamp in the corner, natural room sound and laughter. 8 seconds.

prompts.label: Variation: business behind the scenes
prompts.text: Handheld 2004 camcorder footage of a small bakery before opening: trays of cinnamon rolls come out of the oven, flour in the air, a baker waves at the camera. 4:3 frame, washed-out colours, slight shake, auto-focus hunting, timestamp in the corner, warm natural sound. 8 seconds.

prompts.label: Variation: from your photo
prompts.text: Use the image as the first frame. Make it look like 2004 camcorder footage: the people in it start moving naturally and laughing, the camera shakes a little, colours wash out slightly, a timestamp appears in the corner. Describe nothing else. 6 seconds.

tips: Ask for "4:3". The square frame is half the retro effect.
Keep the action simple: one thing happening in one room.
Label it as AI-made where the platform asks, especially if it shows people.
